verses.gurmukhi: ਜੈਸੇ ਏਕ ਸਮੈ ਦ੍ਰੂਮ ਸਫਲ ਸਪਤ੍ਰ ਪੁਨ ਏਕ ਸਮੈ ਫੂਲ ਫਲ ਪਤ੍ਰ ਗਿਰ ਜਾਤ ਹੈ ॥
verses.translit_en: jaise ek samai dhraoom safal sapatr pun ek samai fool fal patr gir jaat hai ||

en.bdb: Just as a tree is full of fruits and leaves at one time and then at another time, all leaves, fruits etc. fall off.

verses.gurmukhi: ਸਰਿਤਾ ਸਲਲ ਜੈਸੇ ਕਬਹੂ ਸਮਾਨ ਬਹੈ ਕਬਹੂੰ ਅਥਾਹ ਅਤਿ ਪ੍ਰਬਲ ਦਿਖਾਤ ਹੈ ॥
verses.translit_en: saritaa salal jaise kabahoo samaan bahai kabahoo(n) athaeh at prabal dhikhaat hai ||

en.bdb: Just as a stream flows calmly at a place but at another place it is rapid and noisy.

verses.gurmukhi: ਏਕ ਸਮੈ ਜੈਸੇ ਹੀਰਾ ਹੋਤ ਜੀਰਨਾਂਧਰ ਮੈ ਏਕ ਸਮੈ ਕੰਚਨ ਜੜੇ ਜਗਮਗਾਤ ਹੈ ॥
verses.translit_en: ek samai jaise heeraa hot jeeranaa(n)dhar mai ek samai ka(n)chan jaRe jagamagaat hai ||

en.bdb: Just as a diamond is wrapped in a (silk) rag at one time. but at another time, the same diamond is inlaid in gold and shines with its grandeur.

verses.gurmukhi: ਤੈਸੇ ਗੁਰਸਿਖ ਰਾਜ ਕੁਆਰ ਜੋਗੀਸੁਰ ਹੈ ਮਾਯਾ ਧਾਰੀ ਭਾਰੀ ਜੋਗ ਜੁਗਤਿ ਜਗਾਤ ਹੈ ॥੪੯੭॥
verses.translit_en: taise gursikh raaj kuaar jogeesur hai maayaa dhaaree bhaaree jog jugat jagaat hai ||497||

en.bdb: Similarly, an obedient Sikh of the Guru is a prince at one time and a supreme ascetic at another time. Even when he is wealthy, he still remains absorbed in the methods of realisation of the Lord.  (497)
